# What worked

Changes whose gain was measured, with the number before and after, largest first within a group.

## Cost and speed

* [The plan reviewer runs on about two fifths fewer tokens without the batch-your-tree-checks instruction](notes/2026-09-13-the-plan-reviewer-s-instruction-to-batch-its-tree.md): **cuts tokens by 38% (1.3M → 800k)** [agent/plan-reviewer] ([2026-09-12-tokbatch-1](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-09-12-tokbatch-1.md)) - 2026-09-13 [watch: no watch]
* [One `coder` now builds a full-stack change, with no frontend/backend fence](notes/2026-08-04-fe-be-coder-split-one-unfenced-coder-for-fullstack.md): **cuts cost by 36% ($140.93 → $89.97)** [agent/coder] ([2026-07-12-seam-ab-r2](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-07-12-seam-ab-r2.md)) - 2026-08-04 [watch: no watch]
* [/code asks the user through say.md, and an adopted plan change gets a plan-edit coder before the review](notes/2026-10-19-code-asks-the-user-through-say-md-and-an-adopted.md): **cuts wall-clock by 31% (3680 → 2540)** [skill/code, script/code-step] ([2026-10-19-plan-impact-bench-for-code-one-disagreement-asked](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-10-19-plan-impact-bench-for-code-one-disagreement-asked.md)) - 2026-10-19 [watch: TOO FEW]
* [/review launches the scripted review loop](notes/2026-10-30-review-launches-the-scripted-review-loop.md): **cuts cost by 29% ($2.96 → $2.11)** [skill/review, script/review-fix, script/review-loop-script, script/code-step, script/handback] ([2026-10-26-scripted-review-loop-with-bounded-re-review-vs](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-10-26-scripted-review-loop-with-bounded-re-review-vs.md)) - 2026-10-30 [watch: NO DATA YET]
* [/code now runs its review loop as a script instead of an agent](notes/2026-10-27-code-runs-the-review-loop-as-a-script.md): **cuts cost by 29% ($2.96 → $2.11)** [script/code-step, script/review-loop-script, script/format-changed] ([2026-10-26-scripted-review-loop-with-bounded-re-review-vs](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-10-26-scripted-review-loop-with-bounded-re-review-vs.md)) - 2026-10-27 [watch: TOO FEW]
* [The coder's preloaded core now holds its contract only](notes/2026-09-14-the-coder-s-preloaded-core-is-now-its-contract.md): **cuts tokens by 18% (950k → 780k)** [shared/plan-reading, skill/coder-core] ([2026-09-14-codercore-1](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-09-14-codercore-1.md)) - 2026-09-14 [watch: no watch]
* [/code runs as plain prompt steps with no code-step script](notes/2026-10-31-code-runs-as-plain-prompt-steps-with-no-code-step.md): **cuts cost by 15% ($7.86 → $6.66)** [skill/code, script/code-step, agent/code-fork, skill/eng-spec, agent/spec-criteria, script/review-loop-script, script/handback] ([2026-10-31-code-skill-without-the-code-step-script-8-runs-per](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-10-31-code-skill-without-the-code-step-script-8-runs-per.md)) - 2026-10-31 [watch: no reading]

## Quality

* [`code-reviewer` now runs on opus and catches defects sonnet missed](notes/2026-08-08-code-reviewer-pinned-to-opus.md): **raises substantive true findings per review by 226% (1.583 → 5.167)** [agent/code-reviewer] - 2026-08-08 [watch: no watch]
* [`code-reviewer` files taste breaks such as dead code and single-use pass-throughs as `fix`, not `nit`](notes/2026-10-14-code-reviewer-files-taste-breaks-as-fix-not-nit.md): **cuts planted taste defects not filed as fix (of 28) by 100% (14 → 0)** [agent/code-reviewer, skill/fix] ([2026-10-14-catchlist-sealed-4-runs-per-arm](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-10-14-catchlist-sealed-4-runs-per-arm.md)) - 2026-10-14 [watch: TOO FEW]
* [plan-reviewer now flags oversized phases, a skeleton phase with no Phase 0 contract, and criteria files over 8 criteria](notes/2026-10-12-plan-reviewer-a-new-finding-class-phase-shape.md): **cuts planted shape defects missed (of 9) by 100% (9 → 0)** [agent/plan-reviewer] ([2026-10-09-planfmt-sealed-planfmt-md-graded-edit](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-10-09-planfmt-sealed-planfmt-md-graded-edit.md)) - 2026-10-12 [watch: TOO FEW]
* [`code-reviewer` checks each added line against every written rule in the conventions doc, the docs it names and the loaded CLAUDE.md files](notes/2026-10-12-code-reviewer-checks-each-added-line-against-each.md): **cuts planted naming breaks not filed as fix (of 64) by 93% (15 → 1)** [agent/code-reviewer, rule/global-claude-md, skill/fix] ([2026-10-12-namefix-sealed-8-runs-per-arm](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-10-12-namefix-sealed-8-runs-per-arm.md)) - 2026-10-12 [watch: no watch]
* [The coder's core skill now requires a report line for each read of the code that sets a field](notes/2026-09-18-the-coder-s-core-skill-now-makes-the-read-of-the.md): **cuts planted plan defects shipped with no flag (of 8 runs) by 80% (5 → 1)** [skill/coder-core] ([2026-09-18-codercore-5](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-09-18-codercore-5.md)) - 2026-09-18 [watch: no watch]
* [The coder's core skill now tells the coder to check the plan against the code it names](notes/2026-09-18-the-coder-s-core-skill-gained-a-block-that-tells.md): **cuts planted plan defects shipped with no flag (of 8 runs) by 80% (5 → 1)** [skill/coder-core] ([2026-09-18-codercore-3](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-09-18-codercore-3.md)) - 2026-09-18 [watch: no watch]
* [The review loop now gives the fix coder the advisory items of the same review pass](notes/2026-09-20-the-review-loop-now-gives-the-fix-coder-the.md): **cuts real small defects left uncorrected (of 4) by 75% (4 → 1)** [agent/review-loop, skill/branch-recap] ([2026-09-20-loopnit-1](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-09-20-loopnit-1.md)) - 2026-09-20 [watch: no watch]
* [Coder hand-back gate lists stale comment and doc lines](notes/2026-10-25-coder-hand-back-gate-lists-stale-comment-and-doc.md): **cuts stale doc lines missed (of 15 planted) by 72% (12.1 → 3.4)** [agent/coder, skill/code, agent/code-reviewer] ([2026-10-25-stale-prose-hand-back-check-with-a-value-only](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-10-25-stale-prose-hand-back-check-with-a-value-only.md)) - 2026-10-25 [watch: TOO FEW]
